title: Recognizer Research
phase: Rhythm reliability: new-evidence and pulse-interpretation feasibility
summary: Current best observed8%tempo-failure incidence remains39.07%(59/151). Below30%needs14netrescues. A fixed-five-view oracle cannot reach it; expanded candidate coverage indicates interpretation headroom, not achieved accuracy. Next priority: frozen modern-backbone baseline, then matched temporal decoders; no new model run started.

milestones.title: Audit and research design
milestones.detail: Eight areas reviewed; native Dereck review obtained; 36-step protocol approved after two corrections. Protocol approval is not empirical validation.

milestones.title: Frozen rhythm baseline
milestones.detail: Ten rhythm-only executions completed: four copied local development recordings and six synthetic controls. Four adapter tests pass. Original source/audio checksums are retained; the full app was not run.

milestones.title: Task-separated scoring harness
milestones.detail: Task-separated standard-library prototype: 18 tests pass, including exhaustive small event-match checks. The CLI was exercised on all ten actual baseline outputs. All-octave diagnostics differ from the historical restricted half/original/double score; continuity remains deferred.

milestones.title: Blinded reference and source eligibility
milestones.detail: Blinded manual, blank forms, disagreement/effort logs, structural validator and rights/overlap inventory are prepared. Five validator tests pass. No human annotation or listening packet is claimed.

milestones.title: Historical pulse-error diagnosis
milestones.detail: All 78 guitar and 115 drum retained predictions reaggregated. Nine missing-media exclusions remain explicit. Reference-informed correction is only an oracle diagnostic.

milestones.title: Independent validation of execution increment
milestones.detail: Independent scientific and frontend reviews approve this preparatory increment, not musical validity. Bounded independent adapter reproduction passed all four tests with writable temporary and Numba-cache directories, closing the earlier environment-only verification gap.

milestones.title: Retraining and architecture lane
milestones.evidence_type: Prospective experiment design and independent correction/closure review
milestones.detail: A 23-arm candidate matrix covers unchanged/simple baselines, a lightweight trained head, limited fine-tuning and conditional architecture controls. Six review corrections are applied; fresh independent review approves design coherence only. The subsequent bounded selector pilot completed with no gain; larger arms still require fresh resource, rights, label and split preflight.

milestones.title: Independent musical confirmation
milestones.detail: The local inventory establishes zero presently eligible new composition-independent, rights-evidenced confirmation sources; shortfall: twelve for the planned feasibility batch. Two independent musical annotators are also not yet recruited.

milestones.title: Training execution preflight
milestones.evidence_type: Measured inventory, source/rights checks and bounded execution
milestones.detail: All 151 existing inputs were hashed and processed. Local pilot completed within the approved envelope; labels remain weak metadata BPM and the source grouping is only two whole-corpus transfer folds.

milestones.title: Advance local-pilot estimate
milestones.evidence_type: Owner approval and measured local pilot
milestones.detail: Owner approved the 3-hour / 256 MiB envelope. Research and technical closure took about 21 minutes; recorded fitting totaled 27.4 seconds across corrective reruns. Roughly 6 MiB of research artifacts were retained at closure. No cloud jobs/purchases; electricity and normal assistant billing excluded.

milestones.title: Local training pilot: completed, no gain
milestones.evidence_type: Actual fits, exact saved-result verification and independent technical closure
milestones.detail: 151 recordings; 24 distinct final model/fold/seed fits. Frozen mean error 25.02%, linear 37.19%, width32 MLP 35.41–37.45%. Fifteen tests pass; 2,265 predictions and 45 summaries verified. No production model change or broad musical validity is claimed.

milestones.title: Diverse final-run data and budget gate
milestones.detail: Final runs must cover varied genres and full-song/audio types, with rights-evidenced labels, independent source/artist/composition grouping and category-level results. Current guitar/drum data do not satisfy this. A separate advance time/cost/storage estimate is required before larger acquisition/fitting.

milestones.title: Task-specific preprocessing literature check
milestones.evidence_type: Primary-source reconnaissance and explicit contrary evidence; no local preprocessing gain
milestones.detail: Read recent CASM and MuScriptor work, separation-fidelity risks and positive/negative chord-remix evidence. Current adapter already has a median-onset control; the failed pilot used mean onsets. New papers inspire falsifiable controls, not automatic model replacement.

milestones.title: Five-view preprocessing pilot completed
milestones.evidence_type: Actual fixed-model DSP execution, exact baseline parity and independent numerical/outcome review
milestones.detail: 15tests,8controls,151cases/755outputs; zero failures. All151baseline outputs and source hashes match. Percussive+median has lowest observed mean among five inspected views, but6cases improve/5worsen,140unchanged and27severe errors remain. Initial pressure pause resolved within the original2-hour/128 MiB limits. No production promotion or broad musical claim.

milestones.title: Dataset error-incidence scoring adopted
milestones.evidence_type: Explicit owner policy and deterministic saved-prediction rescoring
milestones.detail: Primary: percentage of intended recordings above the prespecified tolerable threshold; current tempo8%. Separate severe>50%, missing and combined unacceptable/missing rates. Five scorer tests and160group/view count checks pass. Original experiment and all predictions preserved; other tasks need their own tolerances.

milestones.title: Sub-30% target assessed—not achieved
milestones.evidence_type: Saved-output arithmetic, fresh primary-source/benchmark review and independent read-only critique
milestones.detail: Twenty research questions; four headroom tests;2265saved selector predictions across15arm/seed groups rescored. Current target45/151failures,14netcorrections. Current source application and historical predictions unchanged; no downloads/training/inference.

findings.title: Current primary score: above-tolerance dataset percentage
findings.detail: At8% BPM tolerance: original mean41.06%(62/151), original median41.72%(63/151), percussive mean41.06%(62/151), percussive median39.07%(59/151), harmonic median49.01%(74/151). All have zero missing predictions. Baseline and percussive median severe>50%incidence both17.88%(27/151). Each offending recording counts once, regardless of error size.
findings.evidence_type: Owner-directed post-hoc incidence reanalysis of unchanged pilot outputs
findings.confidence: HIGH for saved-data arithmetic; no independent musical/generalization validation
findings.source: Threshold-incidence policy and rescoring,2026-10-27; direct deterministic computation. Historical mean-error findings below are secondary, not failure rates.

findings.title: Existing five preprocessing outputs have a fixed-pool limit
findings.detail: Even reference-informed perfect selection among those exact five outputs leaves48/151=31.79%above8%tempo tolerance. This is not a bound on all preprocessing or the expanded candidate bank. Of current59failures,29are mathematically half/double-compatible with reference BPM; actual reference-blind correction remains unproved.
findings.evidence_type: Post-hoc fixed saved-output diagnostic; not a deployable oracle
findings.confidence: HIGH for fixed-data arithmetic; LOW for achievable benefit

findings.title: Candidate availability is not selection performance
findings.detail: The earlier expanded bank contains a within8%candidate for149/151recordings, but its reference-informed1.32%oracle failure is NOT model performance. Actual incidence: linear48.34%, MLP47.68–49.01%. Fresh papers and benchmark trade-offs favor testing stronger frozen rhythm evidence before assuming decoder-only rescue.
findings.evidence_type: All saved selector seeds rescored; targeted academic/benchmark synthesis
findings.confidence: HIGH for saved-output arithmetic; MEDIUM for research priority, no forecast
findings.source: Selector incidence crosscheck and literature review,2026-10-27; eventF1scores are not recording-level8%failure rates.

findings.title: Pulse-level mistakes dominate a large share of retained drum error
findings.detail: Using the predeclared descriptive 4% reference-relative half/double-nearness rule, 22 of 115 drum records account for 64.49% of summed exact relative error. The corresponding guitar values are 3 of 78 and 14.32%. This is retained-development arithmetic, not a new model gain or proof of perceptual correctness.
findings.confidence: HIGH for the retained arithmetic; generalization unestablished
findings.source: diagnosis/RESULTS.md and diagnosis.json, 2026-10-24; internal development evidence

findings.title: The frozen baseline reproduces a numerical half-rate case
findings.detail: On a synthetic 180-pulse-per-minute control, the unchanged estimator returns 89.1 BPM. Silence, DC and the tested sustained tone return unavailable BPM. These controls establish numerical behavior only, not musical accuracy.
findings.confidence: HIGH for this pinned execution only

findings.title: Reference availability, not file availability, is the immediate bottleneck
findings.detail: The scoped local inventory found 1,241 media files and 746 existing benchmark audio memberships. Repeated/inspected material, isolated notes, uncertain composition identity and rights/overlap gaps mean zero sources are yet demonstrated eligible for new independent confirmation. This does not mean every local recording is unusable.
findings.confidence: HIGH for scoped counts and documented eligibility status; broader availability unknown

findings.title: A close 2026 architecture baseline changes the novelty boundary
findings.detail: Explore This! already learns a tatum grid and joint beat/downbeat metrical interpretations. Joint pulse/grid modeling alone is therefore not a sufficient novelty claim. Its reported limitations motivate candidates, but no local performance claim is replicated. The primary PDF and original reproduction-code commit were inspected.
findings.evidence_type: Primary academic paper, official conference page and released source
findings.confidence: HIGH on verified existence/overlap; local transfer unverified
findings.source: Kihlborg, Holzapfel and Schlüter, Explore This! (ISMIR 2026); https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14817 and https://github.com/CPJKU/explore_this

findings.title: Small learned selectors failed cross-corpus transfer
findings.detail: Pooled exact metadata BPM mean error increased from 25.017% frozen to 37.187% linear and 35.413–37.446% MLP. Above-50% error cases increased from 27/151 to 48/151 linear and 49–52/151 MLP. Lower medians for some arms did not compensate for worse tails. No learned checkpoint is promoted.
findings.evidence_type: Actual training on opposite-corpus development folds; verified saved predictions
findings.confidence: HIGH for this bounded numerical result; broad musical generalization unestablished
findings.source: local selector pilot results, verification and independent technical closure, 2026-10-27; direct execution and technical review

findings.title: Candidate support is not successful selection
findings.detail: A reference-informed candidate oracle has 1.066% mean error; candidates within 8% metadata BPM exist for 36/36 guitar and 113/115 drum recordings. This is a diagnostic ceiling, not an achieved model gain or evidence of perceptually correct musical pulse.
findings.evidence_type: Reference-informed diagnostic over the frozen extracted candidate bank
findings.confidence: HIGH for the arithmetic only; no achieved improvement
findings.source: local selector pilot candidate-support and oracle records, 2026-10-27; internal diagnostic

findings.title: Historical mean-error diagnostic: modest, fragile signal
findings.detail: Mean exact metadata BPM error: original25.0171%, raw median24.7568%, percussive mean24.7402%, percussive median24.2945%, harmonic median30.5686%. Lowest observed mean arm improves6/worsens5/unchanged140; within8%89->92, severe errors27->27. Original median has fewer severe errors25. No universal cleanup or production recommendation.
findings.evidence_type: Executed five-view DSP comparison and independent saved-prediction arithmetic review
findings.confidence: HIGH for these inspected numerical outputs; musical/generalization benefit unverified
findings.source: Preprocessing pilot results, verification and independent outcome review,2026-10-27; direct execution and read-only review.

findings.title: Effects differ by category; pulse ambiguity survives
findings.detail: Percussive+median mean error guitar20.5457->20.1876%, drums26.4168->25.5801%; three extra within8% cases are drums. Guitar accompaniment and >90s recordings are unchanged for this arm. All32category groups retained privately. The180-pulse numerical control still returns89.1BPM on original/percussive views.
findings.evidence_type: Executed subgroup/control diagnostics; not independent genre confirmation
findings.confidence: HIGH for scoped arithmetic; no causal or perceptual claim
findings.source: CATEGORY_RESULTS.md, controls and outcome-review.md,2026-10-27; local experimental evidence.

blockers: New independent musical confirmation still needs evidenced composition-independent, rights-cleared sources and two independent musical annotators. That blocks confirmation claims, not all exploratory training.
A concrete training-label, source-group split, checkpoint and resource-smoke protocol must be frozen before fitting. Existing session BPM labels do not supply perceptual beat/downbeat/meter truth.
No trained candidate gain, source-held-out confirmation, continuity validation or empirical paper is established. Paid compute and production changes are not authorized.
next_steps: Keep the unchanged production estimator. Retain percussive+median as a candidate for diverse independent confirmation, not a deployed default or universally best arm.

First scope a frozen modern beat-backbone baseline with fixed scalar-BPM readout and training-overlap audit; then compare direct/CASM/broad-support temporal decoding on identical activations. Give a separate advance resource estimate before model downloads or substantial execution.
Retain the unchanged estimator: do not promote the failed small selectors.
Inventory diverse rights-evidenced full-song/audio types and genre labels; freeze a coverage matrix, independent source/artist/composition splits and category-level reporting.
Provide a separate advance time/cost/storage estimate before acquiring data or starting larger training/fine-tuning.
Resolve independent musical timing/pulse references and confirmation gaps; inspected metadata-based transfer tests are development evidence only.

activity.result: Primary above8%rate41.06%baseline vs39.07%percussive+median; severe incidence17.88%unchanged. Five tests and160group/view checks pass. No new inference or training.

activity.title: Below30%feasibility assessed without a new model run
activity.action: Computed target and fixed-pool/expanded-bank diagnostics; rescored all15selector arm/seed groups; checked fresh primary papers, contrary MIREX results and read-only critique.
activity.result: Research target remains unproved. Modern frozen-backbone baseline first, matched decoding second; no tolerance widening or production change.

limits: Deployed checkpoints, not second-by-second monitoring. Refresh after a milestone deployment.
Synthetic controls test numerical behavior, not musical correctness.
Old diagnostic recordings are not fresh confirmation material.
CLPR remains the flagship. This is a proposed task-specific recognizer-qualification lane; rhythm/meter accuracy does not validate register or note-density constructs.

This local pilot uses only guitar/drum corpora and weak global BPM labels; it cannot satisfy the owner’s final-run diversity requirement. The final diverse acquisition/training run is not started or budgeted.

Scoring update: use above-tolerance incidence as the current headline; historical mean relative error is not the percentage of recordings that failed. The8%threshold is specific to this tempo benchmark, not a universal tolerance for chords/instruments/beat timing.
